baseline_models.mechanism: One intentionally displayed but momentary flash is too thin to settle its outcome, so the same perception bifurcates prospectively into feared harm and hoped-for gain.

activation_trace.role: Causative showing supplies the intentional presentation of the sign.
A momentary flash supplies the visible but temporally thin signal.
Anticipation of harm supplies the negative horizon opened by the flash.
Heartfelt hope supplies the positive horizon opened by the same flash.

changed_reading.before: Lightning is a neutral weather object followed by two audience emotions.
changed_reading.after: Lightning is an intentionally shown, underdetermined sign whose single appearance opens two opposed future horizons at once.

baseline_models.mechanism: The instant flash is followed by an ongoing vertical and horizontal assembly: cloud rises, is brought into being, drags across space, gains mass, and therefore lags behind its own first visible signal.

activation_trace.role: Rising and elevation supply the vertical phase of cloud formation.
Bringing a thing into existence supplies ongoing construction rather than a finished object.
Dragging and extension supply horizontal aggregation and motion.
Weight against lightness supplies accumulated material load.
Slowness under heaviness supplies the temporal lag after the flash.

changed_reading.before: The heavy clouds are a static object appended to the lightning.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a process from a sudden visible flash to the slower construction and transport of a loaded cloud body.

baseline_models.mechanism: The displayed flash can provoke both attraction and alarm without guaranteeing rain; the false-flash branch keeps nonfulfillment live rather than forcing every appearance to be a reliable promise.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate showing supplies a presented appearance rather than a completed outcome.
A false glimmer without rain supplies the possibility of an unfulfilled preview.
Inducing fear supplies one effect produced in the viewers.
Inducing hope or appetite supplies the contrary effect produced by the same display.

changed_reading.before: Hope assumes that visible lightning reliably announces rain.
changed_reading.after: The flash may function as a provocative but noncommittal preview, making fear and hope responses to incomplete evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The one-to-many pattern of one water producing differentiated yields makes the two affects less like inconsistency and more like divergent outcomes latent in one atmospheric gift.

activation_trace.role: The single flash supplies the common initiating signal.
Expected harm supplies one possible uptake of that signal.
Expected gain supplies the divergent uptake of that same signal.
Water delivered by pouring or irrigation supplies the common material input.
Things united in one direction supply the oneness of the input.
Differentiated degree and excellence supply unequal outcomes from that input.

structural_cues: 13:3-4 moves from paired produce to adjacent plots receiving one water yet yielding differentiated food.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one watering and differentiated produce; I map that one-to-many structure onto the flash's paired affects. The live alternative is that fear and hope name only ordinary weather reactions.

changed_reading.before: Fear and hope are opposite subjective reactions to the same weather event.
changed_reading.after: Fear and hope register genuinely divergent consequences already latent in one source and one visible signal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah resolves one branch of the flash's ambiguity into reverential dread and selectively landing discharge, so the warning side is not merely an audience mood but a possible directed event.

activation_trace.role: Lightning used in threat supplies the warning register of the focus flash.
Sky thunder with lightning supplies the audible continuation of the focus phenomenon.
Dread expecting harm supplies a nonhuman counterpart to focus fear.
The heavenly crash supplies a discharge with destructive capacity.
Aimed impact supplies selective landing rather than diffuse spectacle.

structural_cues: 13:13 immediately continues the storm sequence with thunder, fear, dispatched bolts, and selected impact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies storm continuity, dread, discharge, and impact; I infer an arrow from displayed warning to possible targeted strike. The alternative is rhetorical juxtaposition without a causal storm sequence.

changed_reading.before: Fear is an internal reaction to spectacular lightning.
changed_reading.after: Fear also answers a displayed warning whose energy may resolve into a selectively striking event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The image of hands extended toward visible water that never reaches the mouth turns hopeful attraction into a model of distance: an appearance can stimulate thirst while withholding fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: A glimmer without realized rain supplies the unfulfilled atmospheric preview.
A decoy placed in a net supplies attraction toward what may not be obtained.
Extending the hand supplies bodily movement toward the desired object.
An open hand held out in request supplies enacted appetite and dependence.
Water itself supplies the object promised by a rain-bearing appearance.
Arrival at the goal supplies the intended endpoint, which the ayah's negation blocks.

structural_cues: 13:14 repeats reaching language around a water image while explicitly denying arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible water, reaching hands, and blocked arrival; I connect that geometry to the false-flash and decoy branches. The alternative is that the prayer simile has no meteorological return.

changed_reading.before: The hope awakened by lightning remains a credible expectation pending rain.
changed_reading.after: The hope may be thirst drawn toward an apparent water-promise that remains structurally out of reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: Causative showing guarantees exposure but not insight: lightning supplies literal light, while the blind/sighted contrast separates optical presentation from perceptive uptake.

activation_trace.role: Showing supplies exposure of an object to a viewer.
The flash supplies literal momentary illumination.
Blindness of inner perception supplies failed uptake despite exposure.
Insight of the heart supplies the stronger sense of successful seeing.
Illumination supplies the field in which sight can occur without ensuring it.

structural_cues: 13:16 asks whether blind and seeing, darkness and light, can be equal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shown flash and explicit sight/light contrasts; I infer that the showing tests reception rather than causing insight. The alternative is a purely physical contrast with no return to the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: To be shown lightning is simply to see it.
changed_reading.after: The showing exposes everyone to light but leaves open whether the event becomes perception, fear, hope, or no insight at all.

context_deltas.mechanism: The heavy cloud becomes a measured reservoir: release descends into differently capacious channels, where one water can become dangerous torrent and transient foam while its benefit settles and remains.

activation_trace.role: Dragged extension supplies the mobile carrier before release.
Material weight supplies stored load in the carrier.
Expected harm supplies the torrent side of the loaded water.
Expected benefit supplies the enduring-water side of the same load.
Delivery downward supplies the cloud's release phase.
A bounded measure supplies each channel's receiving capacity.
Flowing torrent supplies the dangerous kinetic outcome.
Floating froth supplies conspicuous but nonenduring excess.
Staying with patient duration supplies the beneficial residue.

structural_cues: 13:17 sequences descent, capacity, flood, rising foam, disappearance, and remaining benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a loaded cloud and a measured runoff sequence; I infer reservoir-to-release continuity and align fear/hope with destructive flow/enduring benefit. The alternative is that 13:17 is only an independent truth/falsehood simile.

changed_reading.before: Heavy clouds merely promise rain or storm.
changed_reading.after: Their heaviness is stored potential whose measured release can produce both feared overflow and hoped-for lasting benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cloud's valuable load becomes mobile provision under expansion and constriction, so fear and hope concern not only weather safety but the uncertain apportionment of sustenance.

activation_trace.role: A cloud drawn through the air supplies the mobile distributor.
Precious weight supplies valuable rather than merely cumbersome cargo.
Hope for gain supplies expectation of receiving the cargo.
Expansion and abundance supply one mode of distribution.
Rain descending as provision explicitly joins weather to sustenance.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the contrary mode of distribution.

structural_cues: 13:26 juxtaposes expansion and restriction of provision before evaluating present enjoyment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-as-provision and expansion/constriction; I treat the heavy cloud as its carrier and fear/hope as responses to allotment. The alternative is that the provision statement remains economically abstract.

changed_reading.before: Hope seeks rain as an undifferentiated benefit.
changed_reading.after: Hope and fear face a valuable but unevenly apportioned provision whose carrier is visibly heavy before anyone knows the share.

context_deltas.mechanism: A demanded visible sign does not itself produce guidance or settledness; the flash's affective oscillation is therefore functional, while guidance and remembrance provide a different route to a quiet heart.

activation_trace.role: Showing supplies visual disclosure without a guarantee of assent.
Fear supplies one unsettled response to disclosure.
Hope supplies the coexisting unsettled response.
A manifest sign supplies the very object demanded as proof.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies an operation distinct from mere display.
Settled calm supplies the stable state that the flash itself does not yield.
The heart supplies the site where durable settledness must occur.

structural_cues: 13:27 repeats the demand for a sign, then 13:28 locates settledness in hearts through remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demanded signs, guidance, and heart-settling; I infer that optical showing is intentionally insufficient for settled conviction. The alternative is that the passages describe separate audiences without commenting on the flash.

changed_reading.before: A displayed sign should resolve uncertainty in its viewers.
changed_reading.after: The shown flash can intensify fear/hope without settling judgment; perceptual evidence and guided tranquility are different operations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation of cloud is paired with a branch in which wind erases cloud, then with establishment and inscription: the heavy formation can be read as a mutable atmospheric trace rather than an inevitable completed delivery.

activation_trace.role: Bringing into existence supplies inscription-like formation.
The moving cloud supplies the trace that can persist or vanish.
A wind that erases cloud supplies literal atmospheric cancellation.
Strengthening and fixing supplies the opposed operation of making a trace hold.
Inscription that establishes judgment or measure supplies the governing register.

structural_cues: 13:39 places erasure and establishment in tension before naming the mother of the book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cloud creation, a cloud-erasing wind branch, establishment, and book; I supply the arrow that treats cloud as mutable inscription. The live alternative is that 13:39 concerns decree alone and the cloud branch is only lexical resonance.

changed_reading.before: Once the heavy cloud is created, its rain-bearing outcome appears inevitable.
changed_reading.after: The cloud is a weighty but revisable atmospheric inscription that may be established, moved, or erased before fulfillment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetition of causative showing with only part of a promised outcome recasts lightning as a permitted, timed sample: the flash discloses enough to activate fear and hope while the heavy cloud withholds the remainder.

activation_trace.role: Causative showing supplies the first controlled disclosure.
A glimmer without present fulfillment supplies preview rather than completion.
The loaded cloud supplies the still-withheld remainder behind the flash.
Permission to proceed supplies control over whether a sign appears.
A fixed temporal limit supplies timing for disclosure and completion.
Inscription that establishes a decree supplies the event's measured schedule.
Repeated causative showing supplies an explicit later analogue to the focus verb.
A separated part supplies partial rather than exhaustive disclosure.
A promising indication supplies an approaching outcome sampled in advance.

structural_cues: 13:38 limits signs by permission and term; 13:40 repeats showing with only part of what is promised.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permission, term, inscription, partial showing, and promise; I infer that the lightning flash works as a timed sample of a larger loaded event. The alternative is that the later showing refers only to historical judgment.

changed_reading.before: The flash is either a reliable rain sign or a false one.
changed_reading.after: It may instead be a true but partial preview whose withheld remainder explains why fear and hope coexist.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-reads meteorological formation through animal and human gestation branches. It remains anchored in يُنشِئُ and ثِقَال and is activated by carrying, womb, measure, unseen, and witnessed cues; downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy, not as a lexical claim that the cloud is literally pregnant.

activation_trace.role: The beginning of pregnancy supplies incipient hidden formation.
A body made heavy by pregnancy supplies the loaded-carrier image.
A great hard-raining cloud supplies latent saturation behind the act of showing.
Hidden pregnancy and fruit-bearing supply an internal payload.
The womb supplies a bounded chamber of development.
Measured limit supplies calibrated growth of the payload.
Concealment from eyes supplies the load's hidden phase.
Presence under observation supplies the flash as outward disclosure.

changed_reading.before: A heavy cloud is an inert container of water.
changed_reading.after: The cloud can be imagined as a developing carrier whose hidden measured load first declares itself through a visible flash.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers cloud weight into a social and covenantal register through the non-dominant ر و ي mapping. It remains anchored in the focus's weight and burden-bearing branches and in later binding, connecting, and patient-carrying cues; downstream prose should label it a cross-domain analogy, never the primary sense of السحاب الثقال.

activation_trace.role: Leaders who carry communal liabilities supply a social burden-bearing image.
A precious weight of consequence supplies value and obligation together.
A preserved covenant supplies the obligation being carried.
A binding tie supplies the load's constraining force.
Unbroken succession supplies maintenance of what must remain connected.
Bearing a guarantee with persistence supplies the human analogue of carrying weight.

changed_reading.before: Cloud heaviness denotes only accumulated water mass.
changed_reading.after: Its burden-bearing can also image the costly preservation of a connected obligation until its benefit is delivered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a watercourse image from a form whose surface sense is coming, then joins it to edge-loss. It remains anchored in the dragged heavy cloud and the focus's fear/hope duality; downstream prose should present only an ecological material analogy in which the same loaded water nourishes and erodes, not claim that 13:41 explicitly describes rainfall erosion.

activation_trace.role: Dragging a mass through space supplies approaching material force.
Physical weight supplies erosive as well as nourishing capacity.
Expected damage supplies the erosive horizon.
Expected benefit supplies the nourishing horizon.
A watercourse that opens a path supplies the branch-distant channel for loaded water.
Loss of part of a thing supplies material reduction.
The edge or terminus supplies the site where reduction becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: Rain is hoped for while lightning damage is feared.
changed_reading.after: The same heavy water body may itself carry both benefit and harm by feeding land while wearing away its edges.

strongest_changes: 13:13 sharpens the ambiguous flash into a warning capable of selective impact.
13:17 makes the heavy cloud a measured reservoir whose release yields both dangerous excess and lasting benefit.
13:27-28 weakens any equation of visibility with guidance by separating a shown sign from a settled heart.
13:39-40 makes atmospheric disclosure mutable and partial rather than simply true or false.
summary.what_was_special: The paired fear and hope remained a causal fork instead of being harmonized, while non-dominant and material branches exposed false-preview, gestational, burden-bearing, and erasure models that a weather-only reading would suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the false-flash branch is a live focus possibility or only a lexical echo.
Whether the gestational, covenantal, and erosional analogies should survive into downstream prose.
Whether the cloud-erasing branch in 13:39 licenses an atmospheric inscription reading or only wordplay around decree.
